operation_edge.reason:
PAIR matches the specification for the deployed kobuki diagnostics-to-Android-dashboard connection, including the bringup/aggregator bridge explicitly inside the specified deployed provider boundary. This is not a direct kobuki_node publisher-to-subscriber shortcut inferred from message-type equality. The launch starts the aggregator, its Power System analyzer selects Battery and removes mobile_base, and the dashboard subscribes to diagnostics_agg and selects /Power System/Battery. This supports the intended source/configuration connection, not a live traffic observation or an edge-specific Android permission requirement.
